dz_weather_03.intro: The section Online weather of a place, at the foot of Weather stations, finds a place by name, reads its daily weather of the years you choose from the internet (Open-Meteo, ERA5 reanalysis) and then offers three uses: the weather of the SWAFL project, the weather of every Daisy run, and a log in the list of the plots.
